title.rendered: Meet Muyiwa Bello, the Ebira Musician Reinventing Fuji Through Comedy

content.rendered:
Kinto creator Muyiwa has shared the story behind his unique style of entertainment, blending Fuji music with comedy to create content that has earned him a growing audience. According to him, he is among the pioneers of using the popular Yoruba music genre as a tool for comedy, transforming everyday experiences into humorous performances that resonate with fans.

Muyiwa also spoke about his journey into Kinto creation, his love for Fuji music, and the challenges of building a career in the entertainment industry. Despite not being raised in a predominantly Yoruba environment, he says his passion for the genre inspired him to create a niche that continues to set him apart in Nigeria’s Fuji space.
